session_times_check.name: session_times_check
session_times_check.value: isfinite("auth_sessions"."created_at") and isfinite("auth_sessions"."last_used_at") and isfinite("auth_sessions"."idle_expires_at") and isfinite("auth_sessions"."absolute_expires_at") and "auth_sessions"."created_at" <= "auth_sessions"."last_used_at" and "auth_sessions"."last_used_at" < "auth_sessions"."idle_expires_at" and "auth_sessions"."idle_expires_at" <= "auth_sessions"."absolute_expires_at" and ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is null or isfinite("auth_sessions"."revoked_at"))

desire_reminder_state_check.name: desire_reminder_state_check
desire_reminder_state_check.value: ("desire_reminders"."state" in ('pending','scheduled') and "desire_reminders"."delivered_at" is null) or ("desire_reminders"."state" = 'delivered' and "desire_reminders"."delivered_at" is not null)

desire_reminder_times_check.name: desire_reminder_times_check
desire_reminder_times_check.value: isfinite("desire_reminders"."scheduled_for") and isfinite("desire_reminders"."created_at") and isfinite("desire_reminders"."updated_at") and "desire_reminders"."created_at" <= "desire_reminders"."updated_at" and ("desire_reminders"."last_enqueued_at" is null or isfinite("desire_reminders"."last_enqueued_at")) and ("desire_reminders"."delivered_at" is null or isfinite("desire_reminders"."delivered_at"))

review_note_check.name: review_note_check
review_note_check.value: "desire_review_events"."note" is null or (length(btrim("desire_review_events"."note")) between 1 and 2000 and "desire_review_events"."note"=btrim("desire_review_events"."note"))

review_date_check.name: review_date_check
review_date_check.value: isfinite("desire_review_events"."occurred_at") and (("desire_review_events"."outcome"='delayed' and "desire_review_events"."review_at" is not null and isfinite("desire_review_events"."review_at") and "desire_review_events"."review_at">"desire_review_events"."occurred_at") or ("desire_review_events"."outcome"<>'delayed' and "desire_review_events"."review_at" is null))

review_link_check.name: review_link_check
review_link_check.value: ("desire_review_events"."outcome"='used_owned' and "desire_review_events"."linked_item_id" is not null) or ("desire_review_events"."outcome"='bought') or ("desire_review_events"."outcome" in ('delayed','declined') and "desire_review_events"."linked_item_id" is null)

review_estimate_check.name: review_estimate_check
review_estimate_check.value: ("desire_review_events"."estimated_not_spent_minor" is null and "desire_review_events"."currency" is null) or ("desire_review_events"."outcome"='declined' and "desire_review_events"."estimated_not_spent_minor" is not null and "desire_review_events"."estimated_not_spent_minor">=0 and "desire_review_events"."currency" is not null and "desire_review_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

desire_likely_price_check.name: desire_likely_price_check
desire_likely_price_check.value: ("desires"."likely_price_minor" is null and "desires"."currency" is null) or ("desires"."likely_price_minor" is not null and "desires"."currency" is not null and "desires"."likely_price_minor" >= 0 and "desires"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

desire_product_url_check.name: desire_product_url_check
desire_product_url_check.value: "desires"."product_url" is null or (length("desires"."product_url") between 1 and 2048 and "desires"."product_url" ~ '^https?://')

desire_reason_check.name: desire_reason_check
desire_reason_check.value: "desires"."reason" is null or (length(btrim("desires"."reason")) between 1 and 2000 and "desires"."reason" = btrim("desires"."reason"))

desire_waiting_check.name: desire_waiting_check
desire_waiting_check.value: ("desires"."status" in ('considering','bought','declined','used_owned') and "desires"."waiting_started_at" is null and "desires"."review_at" is null) or ("desires"."status" = 'waiting' and "desires"."waiting_started_at" is not null and "desires"."review_at" is not null and isfinite("desires"."waiting_started_at") and isfinite("desires"."review_at") and "desires"."review_at" > "desires"."waiting_started_at")

contribution_kind_check.name: contribution_kind_check
contribution_kind_check.value: ("goal_contributions"."kind"='contribution' and "goal_contributions"."supersedes_id" is null) or ("goal_contributions"."kind" in ('correction','reversal') and "goal_contributions"."supersedes_id" is not null)

contribution_note_check.name: contribution_note_check
contribution_note_check.value: "goal_contributions"."note" is null or length("goal_contributions"."note") between 1 and 2000

goal_notes_check.name: goal_notes_check
goal_notes_check.value: "goals"."notes" is null or length("goals"."notes") between 1 and 2000

refund_date_precision_check.name: refund_date_precision_check
refund_date_precision_check.value:
("item_refunds"."refund_date_precision" = 'unknown' and "item_refunds"."refund_year" is null and "item_refunds"."refund_month" is null and "item_refunds"."refund_day" is null) or
    ("item_refunds"."refund_date_precision" = 'year' and "item_refunds"."refund_year" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_year" between 1 and 9999 and "item_refunds"."refund_month" is null and "item_refunds"."refund_day" is null) or
    ("item_refunds"."refund_date_precision" = 'month' and "item_refunds"."refund_year" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_year" between 1 and 9999 and "item_refunds"."refund_month" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_month" between 1 and 12 and "item_refunds"."refund_day" is null) or
    ("item_refunds"."refund_date_precision" = 'exact' and "item_refunds"."refund_year" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_year" between 1 and 9999 and "item_refunds"."refund_month" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_month" between 1 and 12 and "item_refunds"."refund_day" is not null and "item_refunds"."refund_day" between 1 and
      case when "item_refunds"."refund_month" = 2 then case when "item_refunds"."refund_year" % 400 = 0 or ("item_refunds"."refund_year" % 4 = 0 and "item_refunds"."refund_year" % 100 <> 0) then 29 else 28 end
      when "item_refunds"."refund_month" in (4,6,9,11) then 30 else 31 end)

refund_note_check.name: refund_note_check
refund_note_check.value: "item_refunds"."note" is null or (char_length("item_refunds"."note") between 1 and 1000 and "item_refunds"."note" = btrim("item_refunds"."note"))

suggestion_status_check.name: suggestion_status_check
suggestion_status_check.value: ("item_suggestions"."status" = 'pending' and "item_suggestions"."decided_at" is null) or ("item_suggestions"."status" in ('accepted','rejected') and "item_suggestions"."decided_at" is not null and isfinite("item_suggestions"."decided_at"))

warranty_dates_check.name: warranty_dates_check
warranty_dates_check.value: ("item_warranties"."starts_on" is null or isfinite("item_warranties"."starts_on")) and ("item_warranties"."expires_on" is null or isfinite("item_warranties"."expires_on")) and ("item_warranties"."starts_on" is null or "item_warranties"."expires_on" is null or "item_warranties"."expires_on" >= "item_warranties"."starts_on")

item_subcategory_requires_category.name: item_subcategory_requires_category
item_subcategory_requires_category.value: "items"."subcategory_id" is null or "items"."category_id" is not null

item_date_precision_check.name: item_date_precision_check
item_date_precision_check.value:
("items"."purchase_date_precision" = 'unknown' and "items"."purchase_year" is null and "items"."purchase_month" is null and "items"."purchase_day" is null) or
    ("items"."purchase_date_precision" = 'year' and "items"."purchase_year" is not null and "items"."purchase_year" between 1 and 9999 and "items"."purchase_month" is null and "items"."purchase_day" is null) or
    ("items"."purchase_date_precision" = 'month' and "items"."purchase_year" is not null and "items"."purchase_year" between 1 and 9999 and "items"."purchase_month" is not null and "items"."purchase_month" between 1 and 12 and "items"."purchase_day" is null) or
    ("items"."purchase_date_precision" = 'exact' and "items"."purchase_year" is not null and "items"."purchase_year" between 1 and 9999 and "items"."purchase_month" is not null and "items"."purchase_month" between 1 and 12 and "items"."purchase_day" is not null and "items"."purchase_day" between 1 and
      case when "items"."purchase_month" = 2 then case when "items"."purchase_year" % 400 = 0 or ("items"."purchase_year" % 4 = 0 and "items"."purchase_year" % 100 <> 0) then 29 else 28 end
      when "items"."purchase_month" in (4,6,9,11) then 30 else 31 end)

media_desire_single_photo_unique.name: media_desire_single_photo_unique
media_desire_single_photo_unique.where: "media_attachments"."desire_id" is not null and "media_attachments"."variant" = 'original' and "media_attachments"."kind" = 'photo' and "media_attachments"."state" <> 'deleted'

media_variant_check.name: media_variant_check
media_variant_check.value: ("media_attachments"."variant" = 'original' and "media_attachments"."parent_id" is null) or ("media_attachments"."variant" in ('display','thumbnail') and "media_attachments"."parent_id" is not null)

media_ready_check.name: media_ready_check
media_ready_check.value: "media_attachments"."state" <> 'ready' or ("media_attachments"."provider_asset_id" is not null and "media_attachments"."provider_version" is not null and "media_attachments"."provider_version" > 0)

media_dimensions_check.name: media_dimensions_check
media_dimensions_check.value: ("media_attachments"."width" is null and "media_attachments"."height" is null) or ("media_attachments"."width" is not null and "media_attachments"."height" is not null and "media_attachments"."width" > 0 and "media_attachments"."height" > 0 and "media_attachments"."width" <= 8192 and "media_attachments"."height" <= 8192 and "media_attachments"."width"::bigint * "media_attachments"."height" <= 24000000)

media_alt_text_check.name: media_alt_text_check
media_alt_text_check.value: "media_attachments"."alt_text" is null or ("media_attachments"."kind" = 'photo' and "media_attachments"."variant" = 'original' and char_length("media_attachments"."alt_text") <= 250 and "media_attachments"."alt_text" = btrim("media_attachments"."alt_text"))

media_type_check.name: media_type_check
media_type_check.value: ("media_attachments"."resource_type" = 'raw' and "media_attachments"."format" = 'pdf' and "media_attachments"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf' and "media_attachments"."kind" <> 'photo') or ("media_attachments"."resource_type" = 'image' and "media_attachments"."byte_size" <= 10485760 and (("media_attachments"."format" = 'jpg' and "media_attachments"."mime_type" = 'image/jpeg') or ("media_attachments"."format" = 'png' and "media_attachments"."mime_type" = 'image/png') or ("media_attachments"."format" = 'webp' and "media_attachments"."mime_type" = 'image/webp')))

notification_ntfy_state_check.name: notification_ntfy_state_check
notification_ntfy_state_check.value: ("notifications"."ntfy_state" = 'pending' and "notifications"."ntfy_attempts" = 0 and "notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at" is null and "notifications"."ntfy_sent_at" is null) or ("notifications"."ntfy_state" = 'sending' and "notifications"."ntfy_attempts" > 0 and "notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at" is not null and "notifications"."ntfy_sent_at" is null) or ("notifications"."ntfy_state" = 'failed' and "notifications"."ntfy_attempts" > 0 and "notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at" is null and "notifications"."ntfy_sent_at" is null) or ("notifications"."ntfy_state" = 'sent' and "notifications"."ntfy_attempts" > 0 and "notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at" is null and "notifications"."ntfy_sent_at" is not null)

notification_times_check.name: notification_times_check
notification_times_check.value: isfinite("notifications"."occurred_at") and isfinite("notifications"."created_at") and isfinite("notifications"."updated_at") and "notifications"."created_at" <= "notifications"."updated_at" and ("notifications"."read_at" is null or isfinite("notifications"."read_at")) and ("notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at" is null or isfinite("notifications"."ntfy_claimed_at")) and ("notifications"."ntfy_sent_at" is null or isfinite("notifications"."ntfy_sent_at"))

user_credentials_check.name: user_credentials_check
user_credentials_check.value: ("users"."email" is null and "users"."password_hash" is null) or ("users"."email" is not null and "users"."password_hash" is not null and "users"."email" = lower(btrim("users"."email")) and length("users"."email") between 3 and 254 and "users"."password_hash" like '$argon2id$%')
